description: I believe healthcare is a basic right. I also believe we cannot leap from where we are now to Medicare for All overnight. But there is a great deal we can do, in one term, to stop the bleeding and start building a system that does not punish people for getting sick.

title: Healthcare Is a Right: Building a Bridge to Better Care | Kelsey Kauffman for Indiana
